manual.title: Custom IVI Source Selection
manual.description: Fictional manual showing how Audio, Sources and a proprietary LinkWave icon are used to select Bluetooth audio.

icons.name: Audio Hub
icons.meaning: Opens playback and media-source controls from the Home tile grid.

icons.name: Sources
icons.meaning: Opens the list of available media inputs.

icons.name: LinkWave / BT Audio
icons.meaning: This proprietary symbol represents Bluetooth audio as a media source.

screens.name: Home - Main tile grid
screens.description: The main launcher contains large tiles. Tile positions can vary by vehicle configuration.
landmarks: Audio tile uses the Audio Hub icon

screens.name: Audio Hub
screens.description: Shows the active source and provides the Sources control.

screens.name: Audio Hub - BT Audio selected
screens.description: BT Audio is the active source and has a visible selected indicator.

screens.name: Audio source selector
screens.description: Lists available audio sources before Bluetooth has been selected.
landmarks: BT Audio row uses the LinkWave icon

tasks.name: Select Bluetooth as the media source
tasks.goal: Select Bluetooth as the media source

steps.instruction: Locate the Audio tile by its label or Audio Hub icon and activate it.

steps.expected: The audio source list is visible

steps.instruction: Locate BT Audio by text, synonym or LinkWave icon and activate it once.
steps.expected: BT Audio becomes the selected source

success: BT Audio has a selected indicator
forbidden: Do not toggle the Bluetooth radio
